description: Remove access for every member and pending invitation (Proton and non-Proton) on a shared path in one call. The server asks the user to approve this itself; run drive_share_status first so you can tell them who loses access. Does NOT remove a public link (the result says if one is active; use drive_share_remove_url). For one person use drive_share_revoke.

confirmed.description: Optional and ignored: the server asks the user to approve this itself. You do not need to send it.

path.description: Absolute remote Drive path to strip all sharing access from (must start with '/').

name: drive_share_remove_all
title: Remove all sharing
